Our detective adventures

Round 5 — Where is it? Choose a sentence frame or a full blank. Find the named item, answer aloud or type your sentence, then reveal the answer. Reshuffle placements restarts all six searches. Voice and sounds have separate switches.

Round 1 — Discover: Move the beam slowly over any missing stationery item. Hold it there briefly to discover it automatically. Hear a chime, see the enlarged picture and read its name. Your picture notebook fills up as you search. Read all six words together at the end.

Round 2 — Where is it? Find the named item. Its picture pops up beside an enlarged location scene. Say the location first. When Hide location answers is on, each discovery starts with the sentence hidden and only the question is spoken. Use Reveal answer to show and hear the correct sentence, or Hide answer to cover it again. Turn the setting off to show sentences immediately. There are no quiz choices in this practice round.

Round 3 — Detective challenge: Name each item, locate it, then complete a conversation between two children. The owner's picture and name show whose item it is.

Mouse: move the beam. Touch: drag a finger. Keyboard: arrow keys; Enter also investigates. Each discovery pauses the timer. Teacher lights show the room and pause searching. Images uploaded as backgrounds stay in this browser unless you save a new HTML copy. Voices depend on your browser/device.
